c1.kind: touching both sides (creases), real ring on finger

c3.kind: shadowed gaps both sides, bent finger

c5.kind: very close+blurred; left soft step to pinky, right shirt

c6.kind: very close; left crease to middle finger, right shirt
c6.note: shirt-side edge (+44) is clear; the crease to the touching middle finger is ambiguous: shadow valley at about -45 (both measurers) vs a redness drop at about -30 (critic). Treat width 74-89 px as acceptable.

c7.kind: backlit+blurred; left washed-out shirt, right faint bright gap
c7.note: backlit and motion-blurred; today's ring is ~30% outside the finger at the lower edge

_conventions.geometry: c = MCP13 + 0.69*(PIP14 - MCP13) in 2D image px using landmarks.json; a = unit 2D MCP->PIP; n = (a_y, -a_x) (equals u in main.ring_pose). left/right = signed edge offsets along n from c at the ring line, px.
_conventions.frames: clean1-7 are the user's display frames (already rotated/mirrored as shown): feed them to RingTracker(mirrored=True). Labels: c1 Right, c2 Left, c3 Left, c4 Left, c5 Right, c6 Left, c7 Left. rh/lh = sample photos (true views, mirrored=False); rh0/rh1 and lh0/lh1 are the two hands in each photo.
_conventions.inpainted_old_ring: in clean1-7 the previously drawn ring/labels were painted out (cv.inpaint): pixels inside the old band around the ring line are synthetic; measure on cross-sections outside it and extrapolate.
_conventions.hand_in_view: false when landmarks fall outside the frame (wrist cut off): c6, c7
_conventions.c4: sideways hand (ring finger hidden behind the pinky): no width GT, the ring must stay hidden; detect with confidence 0.3
_conventions.unc: unc_* are judgement uncertainties in px
_conventions.other_fingers: c1_index / c1_middle use the same convention with that finger's own first bone (Index 5->6, Middle 9->10) instead of 13->14

c1_index.kind: background step / crease valley to the touching middle finger
c1_index.note: added by review: L* profile at the ring row of clean1 (fingers held together)

c1_middle.kind: crease valleys on both sides (fingers held together)
c1_middle.note: added by review: L* profile at the ring row of clean1
